scopeReview: CED FUN-7.D.1–2: general solutions via separation and previously learned antiderivatives. Retain constant solutions lost to division and real/domain/branch restrictions. An invalid-separation question does not ask for a nonseparable equation’s solution. No BC techniques.
varietyReview: Multiplicative exponential, implicit power, inverse tangent/trig family, power-law scaling, lost zero solution, exponential-in-state logarithm, shifted affine family, algebraic nonseparability error, implicit cubic, antiderivative error diagnosis and positive square-root branch. Five sampled family corroborations vary both constant and input alongside exact derivations.
repetitionReview: Each prompt and all four options were read separately; distinct tasks/contexts within this set. Cross-topic exact duplicates checked by validator. Semantic similarity and AP difficulty remain judgment calls, not proven by an automated score.
